title: Glitchy Text on Dark Background
coreRelationships: The light pink text strongly contrasts with the dark, noisy background.
The text is the sole focal point, centrally placed and commanding attention.
The background texture provides a subtle, dynamic energy that counteracts the static nature of the text.
The overall composition is balanced and symmetrical.
reuseFormula: Generate a dark, subtly textured background. Overlay bold, light pink sans-serif text, centered and scaled to be the dominant element.
